game_updates.title: Left 4 Dead 2 - Update
game_updates.contents: An update has been released for Left 4 Dead 2. - Fixed several crashes and exploits reported via HackerOne.

game_updates.title: Portal 2 - Update
game_updates.contents: An update has been released for Portal 2. - Fixed subtitles not playing during end credits. - Fixed not returning to the main menu when credits finish. - Security and exploit fixes reported via HackerOne.

game_updates.title: update 2.0.0
game_updates.contents: ・You can now create clones (Up to 2 clones). Clones count toward the blind spot metrics. If a clone is destroyed, the main body is also destroyed. ・Added TPS view for Hunters. ・Added "Modded" to server tags. ・Added Turkish. ・Fixed an issue where the Mod requirement screen overlapped with the hidden character selection screen. An update adding randomness to stages is scheduled to be released later this week.

game_updates.title: PAYDAY 2: Engine Upgrade Open-Beta Announcement
game_updates.contents: Hello Heisters!It is time to announce the next update coming for the game, and its quite a big one...This is a huge milestone for PAYDAY 2 and it has been a massive undertaking for our team.Some of the improvements are but not limited to:The long awaited port to 64 bitsAn upgrade from DX9 to DX11 renderingGame file size reduction to ~32gbFaster load times on SSDs6 character lobby codesAnd more...With any big change, there are bound to be some bugs, therefore we will have an open beta period running starting from June 30th until the end of July. This should give us time to iron out any potential quirks, and also for modders to get their mods updated. More information will be revealed about the beta test on the 30th.Welcome to the world of tomorrow!Sidetrack Games ː2ːxː2ːxː2ːxː2ːxː2ːxː2ː

game_updates.title: Update 3.0.433. Sand Temple Treasures Event
game_updates.contents: This is a safe PvP event, also available on PvE servers. On death, you do not lose loot or durability. Even beginners can take part, and special event weapons can be purchased for silver.We have also added two event rooms to Shattered Castle, where you can receive similar rewards and complete most quests! The archaeologists of Iteria discovered the ruins of the Sand Temples and carried out excavations, but the expedition did not go as planned: the spirits of the guardians possessed the archaeologists, granting them ancient deadly weapons and filling them with bloodlust. The entire expedition destroyed one another, and sandstorms buried the discoveries. But recently, local residents found the temple ruins, and stories of treasure have once again drawn the interest of Iteria's adventurers.Ob...

game_updates.title: Terraria 1.4.5.7 is finally giving my favorite weapon type the love it's deserved for years
game_updates.contents: There's not much you could have said to get me more excited for the next Terraria update than this. Re-Logic is currently working on a big round of balancing and additional weapon changes for the upcoming patch 1.4.5.7, with the goal of making every class feel worthwhile and fun to play. As part of that, it's finally taking a look at what is unquestionably the most fun offensive option in the sandbox indie game - yoyos. In a new Terraria State of the Game for June 2026, Head of Business Strategy Ted 'Loki' Murphy talks about yoyo upgrades, crossplay plans, and the largest hotfix in Terraria's history. Read the full story on PCGamesN: Terraria 1.4.5.7 is finally giving my favorite weapon type the love it's deserved for years

game_updates.contents: One more fix for today! ✅FIXED: We’ve deployed a PC update to mitigate the recent FPS drops tied to specific hardware. Gameplay should feel much smoother now! We will continue monitoring performance as we work toward a permanent fix in an upcoming patch.

game_updates.title: Midsummer Cawnival is Back!
game_updates.contents: The Cawnival is back in the Constant! Our survivors are once again greeted by the festive feathered Corvus Goodfeather and his crow compatriots. Decorate, try your luck at the Cawnival games, and maybe even win some prizes! This year's star attraction is Mini-golf! Take a swing and one of several pre-built courses for your chance at some tickets, or build your own course for some added fun. Highlights:Start of the annual Midsummer Cawnival event.The master of ceremonies, Corvus Goodfeather can be found near the Florid Postern.Mini-golf! game_updates.title: Enshrouded makes October even busier with a 1.0 release date, more details coming this summer
game_updates.contents: There comes a time in the life of most early access releases that they most abandon that moniker in favour of a fully fledged 1.0 launch. And it appears said time is arriving for Enshrouded, the fantasy survival game that comes with a whole lot of building options, as developer Keen Games GmbH have locked in a 1.0 release date. game_updates.title: ETS2 & ATS: 1.61 Experimental Beta
game_updates.contents: Even though the 1.60 update for both Euro Truck Simulator 2 and American Truck Simulator was released just last week, we are already working on features for future updates. And since we want to gather as much feedback from our #BestCommunityEver, we are starting an experimental beta way in advance of the actual update release, with focus on two upcoming features - the Multi-Function Display and In-Game Menu. To make sure we get it right, we need your help!As mentioned above, this time, we are starting the beta cycle from an early stage. The level of polish and stability in this release might not yet be on the same level as with our typical Open Betas. However, we recognize the importance of involving our community in the development process and need to gather feedback early to help us iden...

game_updates.title: 5 New Languages, 8 New Unique Items
game_updates.contents: Hello Sinners!A lot of you asked to play Mortal Sin in your own language, so this update is a big step toward that. Five new languages, eight new unique items, and a stack of bug fixes. Here's everything:🌍 New LanguagesAdded German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, and Brazilian Portuguese! A handful of passionate players came through and delivered these, and I honestly can't thank them enough. They're still being polished, so if something reads off in your language, let me know and I'll get it sorted.✨ New Unique ItemsFilled out the unique pool so every armor slot has more to roll:Penitent's Bulwark (Armor): huge max HP, but you deal less damage. Spiteguard (Armor): taking damage fires your projectile weapons back at the attacker. Gambler's Grip (Gauntlets): big luck boost at the cost of max HP....

game_updates.title: Conan Exiles Enhanced Community Update - June
game_updates.contents: Greetings, Exiles! It's been just over seven weeks since the launch of Conan Exiles Enhanced, and what an incredible journey it has been so far. Since the game's release, hundred of thousands of players have ventured into the Exiled Lands. We've seen a concurrency peak of over 47,000 players on Steam, countless new stories unfold, and lots of great feedback shared across our community channels. During this time, we've delivered multiple updates focused on quality-of-life improvements, gameplay adjustments, performance enhancements, and bug fixes. Your feedback, reports, discussions, videos, and suggestions continue to shape the future of Conan Exiles Enhanced. Today, we'd like to share an update on some of the topics you've been discussing the most. Thank you for all your incredible suppor...

game_updates.title: June Hotfix 1.3.1
game_updates.contents: Greetings, Exiles! Today, we have a small but mighty update with various fixes for some major issues that you have reported over the last few days. Fixed issue where Elixir of Freedom could increase speed if used while crippled.Fixed an incorrect placement range setting on the Vendhyan Bathhouse.It should be easier to place the bathhouse down.Updated thumbnails for Vendhyan building set pieces to be representative of it’s contents.Fixed an issue that would sometimes display an error when crafting multiple items at once.Fixed issue where unequipping the Spiderclimb Boots could reduce speed when climbing.

game_updates.title: Enshrouded - 1.0 Release Date Reveal
game_updates.contents: Hey Flameborn!Today is a big day for us as we are finally able to reveal the release date for Enshrouded 1.0! No padding to the announcement, there's one video we want you to check out, here it is!Can't watch the video right now? That's okay, the important information is Enshrouded releases out of Early Access on Steam on October 15th! And if you want a peek at some of the many things that are coming with the update, you'll have to take a look at the video...We will bring you more news about improvements, optimization, QoL changes, as well as all the new stuff, later this summer! Until then, make sure you tell your friends, and stay hydrated!The team at Keen Games.

game_updates.title: Patch Notes: Update 2.3.19
game_updates.contents: The previous patch contained a bug causing items to vanish from Display Cabinet. This issue has been resolved in this update. However, players who have already lost items will need to manually restore their save files from a backup created prior to the bug occurring. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused! Save Restoration Guide \On the Save Selection screen, click the Restore Backup​ button in the lower-right corner. Select the desired save slot (e.g., Save 3) and choose a backup dated before the bug occurred. UpdatesAdjusted the Pumpkin model size to match that of the Jack-o'-Lantern.Kills credited to the Coal Briquette​ now count toward player kill statistics.FixesFixed an issue where items on structures like Display Cabinet would disappear.
